name: ESPER.THERAP.(NEW) DL-001
summary: ESPER.THERAP.(NEW) DL-001 is likely referring to Esperion Therapeutics, Inc., a pharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing oral therapies for the treatment of elevated LDL-cholesterol. Esperion's main product is NEXLETOL (bempedoic acid), a non-statin LDL-cholesterol lowering medicine. The company is headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan.
